recognize_zh: 中倍下骨髓組織富含造血細胞，脂肪空泡間散布多顆大型、核分葉的巨核細胞，彼此分開不成群，且無纖維化或異常浸潤，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular-appearing marrow fragment with interspersed fat vacuoles
Megakaryocytes increased and evenly scattered as single cells, not clustered or paratrabecular
Megakaryocytes large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei
Trilineage hematopoiesis with many erythroid precursors and granulocytes in background
No fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates or granulomas in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular fragment with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes are increased and scattered singly throughout the interstitium; they are large, with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei, and lack clustering or significant atypia. There is no evidence of fibrosis, granulomatous inflammation or an infiltrative process in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia as seen in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: ET has loose clusters of very large megakaryocytes with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei and thrombocytosis, whereas here megakaryocytes are dispersed and the patient is thrombocytopenic.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia (e.g., infection, blood loss)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; the distinction is clinical, relying on the context of isolated immune-mediated thrombocytopenia.
MDS shows small hypolobated megakaryocytes and dysplasia in erythroid or granulocytic lineages, not seen here.
